note: One hand-written piece per promoted pick. Every figure quoted was read from the official page recorded in desk.json during this session's read window. No injury, lineup, weather or travel claim is made because none was read.

predictions.headline: Milwaukee +1.25 on the run line to open the World Series
predictions.text: Game 1 at American Family Field and the Brewers are worth backing with a run and a quarter of start. Milwaukee went 103-59 with 832 runs scored and 618 allowed, a +214 differential, and closed the regular season on a five-game run before sweeping the Dodgers in four NLCS games. Jacob Misiorowski takes the ball against Nick Martinez. Tampa Bay are 98-64, but this line only asks Milwaukee to avoid losing by two.

predictions.headline: Same handicap, Game 2: Brewers +1.25 at home again
predictions.text: Logan Henderson against Drew Rasmussen is the second pitching matchup, and the setting is unchanged, which matters because Milwaukee were 55-26 at home this season while Tampa Bay went 43-38 on the road. The Rays scored 736 and conceded 650 across 162 games, a +86 differential, so they are good rather than dominant. With a run and a quarter in hand, the Brewers need only stay within one.

predictions.headline: Over 6.25 runs when the series moves to Tropicana Field
predictions.text: Milwaukee's 162 games produced 1,450 runs, 832 scored and 618 conceded, an average of 8.95. Tampa Bay's produced 1,386, 736 scored and 650 conceded, 8.56 per game. Two clubs that combined to average more than eight and a half runs a game meet at a ballpark where the Rays went 55-26, and the totals line sits at 6.25. That leaves room even for a quieter October night.

predictions.headline: Over 6.25 again for Game 4 in St Petersburg
predictions.text: The same two offences, the same park, four days after the opener. Tampa Bay's ALCS against Cleveland was settled in six games and their 736 runs were the second-highest total of any club still playing. Milwaukee's +214 run differential came from scoring 5.14 a game. Nothing published by MLB before this game suggests a pitching matchup severe enough to drag the expected total below seven.

predictions.headline: Philadelphia to clear two goals against Anaheim
predictions.text: Philadelphia have 31 goals in 11 games, 2.82 per outing, and they meet a Ducks side that has conceded 33 in 10, 3.30 per game. Matvei Michkov has six goals and Trevor Zegras five assists for the Flyers, while Anaheim arrive 4-6-0 with Lukas Dostal on three wins and Beckett Sennecke on five goals. Over 2 on the home team total is the cleanest line in this game.

predictions.headline: Boston over three team goals at TD Garden
predictions.text: The Bruins are 8-2-1 and 4-0-0 at home, where they have scored 21 goals in four games, better than five a night. David Pastrnak has six goals and ten assists, Jeremy Swayman has six wins, and San Jose arrive with one regulation win in eleven attempts despite a 6-4-1 record built on overtime points. Asking Boston for four goals is a demand they have already met in three of four home dates.

predictions.headline: Ottawa over two team goals against the Rangers
predictions.text: Ottawa are 4-2-0 at home and 3-2-0 away, scoring 31 goals in 11 games overall at 2.82 a night. The Rangers have played six road games and conceded 19 goals in them, 3.17 per game, while scoring only eight. Tim Stutzle has seven goals and eight assists, Linus Ullmark seven wins, and Adam Fox fourteen assists for New York. Over 2 on the Senators is the value.

predictions.headline: Los Angeles Kings over three team goals in Newark
predictions.text: Los Angeles average 3.33 goals a game, 30 in nine, with Artemi Panarin on six and Brandt Clarke adding five assists. They now face a New Jersey side that is 6-4-0 yet has conceded 36 goals in 11 games, 3.27 per game, with Jake Allen carrying four wins behind a defence that gives up volume. The Kings have the scoring rate to reach four even if the Devils win the game.

predictions.headline: Dallas +0.5 against the Islanders
predictions.text: Dallas are 6-3-1 and riding a four-game winning run, with 26 goals for and 17 against in ten games. The Islanders are 5-3-2, but 30 scored and 28 conceded is a far thinner margin, and Mikko Rantanen and Jason Robertson give the Stars the top-end edge at American Airlines Center. A half-goal start means any Dallas win, including overtime or a shootout, settles the bet.

predictions.headline: Leinster +1.75 in the Irish derby at the Aviva
predictions.text: Leinster have conceded only 58 points across three United Rugby Championship rounds while scoring 75, and they beat Cardiff 29-5 in Round 3. Munster drew 26-26 at Ulster and carry a points difference of -2 into Dublin. With a start of 1.75, Leinster only need to avoid losing by two or more, and no side in the table has defended as tightly over the opening three rounds.

predictions.headline: Vodacom Bulls to cover eight points at Loftus Versfeld
predictions.text: The Bulls have scored 126 points and conceded 54 in three rounds, a +72 differential that is the best in the competition and 24 points per game. Ulster have drawn twice and lost once, with 88 scored and 93 conceded. The Bulls put 57 on the Lions in Round 3 in Pretoria, so laying eight points with them is the strongest handicap of the round.

predictions.headline: DHL Stormers -2.5 against Scarlets in Cape Town
predictions.text: The Stormers have built a +27 differential in three games, scoring 81 and conceding only 54, and they beat the Sharks 39-22 in Round 3. Scarlets edged Benetton 27-26 but have shipped 85 points in three matches and sit near the bottom of the table. With home advantage at DHL Stadium and a defence conceding 18 a game, the Stormers covering 2.5 stands out.

predictions.headline: Ospreys +10 at St Helen's after beating the Dragons away
predictions.text: Ospreys won the Round 3 meeting 38-31 at Rodney Parade and have scored 81 points in three games. Their -26 points difference comes mostly from a heavy early defeat, which is why the handicap is so generous at home. Dragons have 88 scored and 83 conceded but were beaten by this opponent seven days earlier. Ten points of start asks only that Ospreys stay within nine.

predictions.headline: Benetton +9.25 at Stadio Monigo against Glasgow
predictions.text: Benetton lost by a single point to Scarlets and drew another game, holding a -4 differential across three rounds with 64 scored and 68 conceded. Glasgow are unbeaten with a +23 differential and beat Connacht 36-19, but nine points of start covers the margin they managed against a weaker side. Monigo has been an awkward venue for travelling teams, and Benetton at home are worth the handicap.
